description: Revoke an API key by its ID, permanently deactivating it. WARNING: If you revoke the key this server is using, it loses API access until you set a different valid key (RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY or `rentahuman-mcp setup`). Use list_api_keys first to see key IDs. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.

keyId.description: The ID of the API key to revoke (from list_api_keys).

name: revoke_api_key
title: Revoke API key
